answer: Admission here runs only across a cross-ledger bridge: each new agent must first lock a costly bond on a separate high-fee external chain, the sole on-ramp. A watchdog service, the falcon, randomly audits linked accounts, and any proven clone triggers a ripple of cascade-slashing that burns the bonds of every identity sharing its funding root. So one operator spinning up many fakes pays a real external bond per head and watches them all collapse the moment one is caught.
